why_this_window: Starts 4 bars before the track's main drop (33.168s) so the reel opens on plucks and drops at 0:08.4; the track's one-bar kick dropouts at 47.905s and 64.747s land at 0:23.2 and 0:40.0 in reel time, giving a free breath before the primary suite and again under the deck/logo outro.

sections.name: Intro — plucks
sections.cut_unit: 1 bar (2.11s), last bar split to 2 half-bars
sections.content: Exterior facade with the red maple, push to front door, entry with light-oak herringbone, iron-spindle staircase
sections.notes: Address burn-in ('271 Springfield Ave, Paramus NJ 07652') masked across the whole 0-6s source region it occupies

sections.name: Drop — chef's kitchen
sections.content: Open-concept wide on the drop, white shaker cabinets, quartz island with bold gray veining, unlacquered brass hardware inserts
sections.notes: First cut lands exactly on the kick at music 33.168s

sections.name: Break bar — move upstairs
sections.notes: Track pulls its kick for this bar (music 47.905s) — the hold is what makes the re-entry read

sections.name: Bedrooms & utility
sections.content: Wide-plank rift-sawn oak, bright secondary bedrooms, marble-tiled guest bath, black-and-white checkered laundry
sections.notes: Checkered laundry cuts last — highest contrast hit of the section

sections.name: Primary suite — slower
sections.content: Freestanding soaking tub under the skylight, book-matched marble walk-in shower, dual vanity with arched gold mirrors
sections.notes: Pacing halves against the kitchen while the music stays up — the contrast is the point

sections.name: Lower level — fast sweeps
sections.content: Secondary kitchen, dark quartz counters, brass dome pendants, blue onyx bath
sections.notes: Four hits in one bar — the tightest cutting in the reel

sections.name: Break bar — deck
sections.content: Stabilized sweep across the elevated composite deck and backyard
sections.notes: Second kick dropout (music 64.747s) — the deck gets the reel's only real breath

sections.name: Brand lockup
sections.content: Deck shot continues, fades to a semi-transparent plate, WA Construct logo resolves over it
sections.notes: Logo lands on the lift at music 66.852s; music fades out over the final 1.5s
